sentences.text: The purpose of the meeting was to discuss a letter before proceedings from the council regarding concerns about the client's children, specifically a bruise on Alfie's arm and a 20
The client, Chloe Mason, attended the meeting with the solicitor, Daniel Hughes.
The client has a child named Poppy, who is fourteen months old and walks everywhere.
The client has a child named Alfie, who attends Little Stars nursery on Bank Street, Monday to Friday, mornings.
Alfie is described as a fussy eater who only eats pasta and fish fingers, and sleeps from seven till seven.
The council's letter cites a bruise on Alfie's arm observed by the nursery on the ninth of November.
The council's letter cites a police call to the house in October.
The client stated she told the social worker, Ms Okoye, that Alfie fell off the sofa.
The client denied that Alfie fell off the sofa, stating instead that Jordan slapped him.
The client reported that Jordan slapped Alfie across the face because he would not eat his tea.
The client stated the incident where Jordan slapped Alfie occurred on Sunday the 8th of November at about five o'clock.
The client reported that Jordan grabbed Alfie by the arm, pulled him off the chair, and caused the bruise.
The client stated she was at the sink when she saw the bruise on Alfie's arm.
The client reported that Jordan told her to say Alfie fell off the sofa when Ms Okoye came to speak to her.
The client stated that in October, she and Jordan were arguing and shouting, and a neighbour rang the police.
The client stated the police only talked to them during the October incident.
The client stated Jordan is currently at his mother's house and will return on Saturday.
The client stated Jordan has never taken the children anywhere without her agreement.
The client stated Jordan threatened to take the children and Poppy if she left him.
The client's primary objective is to have her children stay with her.
The client expressed a concern that Jordan might take Alfie even if she leaves him.
The solicitor advised the client to tell Ms Okoye what really happened before the meeting on the first of December.
The solicitor advised that telling the truth and keeping Jordan away protects Alfie and the client in the process.
The solicitor advised that a mum who tells the truth and acts to keep her child safe is in a stronger position than one who backs her partner's story.
The solicitor advised the client that she can ask for her Universal Credit to be paid into her own account.
The client agreed to the solicitor's advice to tell Ms Okoye what really happened.
The solicitor gave permission to write to Ms Okoye with the information provided by the client.
The solicitor stated he would write to Ms Okoye with the client's account.
The solicitor advised the client to ring Harbridge Women's Aid today to discuss a safety plan for when Jordan returns on Saturday.
The solicitor stated he would prepare a non-molestation application.
